purpose: Durable record of already completed focused Stage 06 construction and related regression checks. No tests or lint/format checks were rerun to create this record.

provenance.focusedResults: Recorded from the architecture audit agent's completed tool results and handoff: 8/8 new actual-geometry tests and 54/54 related existing tests passed; local test-file lint and formatting checks passed.
provenance.originalFocusedRawLog: No separate raw focused-test or local single-file lint/format log was retained. This JSON is a retrospective result record, not a reconstructed raw transcript.
provenance.runTimestamp: The exact focused-run timestamp was not retained; runs completed before the structural inventory and the later full isolated-suite verification.
provenance.independentCorroboration: Every one of the 62 case names below is also present as passing in the separately retained isolated full-suite log checks/test.log. Those later checks were performed by the verification agent; their commands, source hashes, results and isolation are recorded in verification-checks.json.

environment.workingDirectory: Main repository working tree; only pure source/geometry/navigation tests explicitly listed below.
environment.serverOrDataFixture: None. These focused commands do not run the API/workflow tests or access D1/R2. Full/mutating tests were run separately in the isolated fixture documented by verification-checks.json.
